title: ^ECOLOGICAL ENGINEERING DESIGN I
description: Explores engineering design processes for ecological engineering applications, including but not limited to specifications, performance criteria, timelines, project logistics, developing alternatives and alternatives selection criteria, and principles and practices of working in engineering teams. Involves a hands-on experience in solving complex, open-ended design problems often encountered in ecological engineering practice, including satisfying physical, legal, economic, social and environmental constraints.
registration_restrictions:
Prerequisite: BEE 322.
A minimum grade of C is required in BEE 322.
